name: Sakura Moonlight
source:
The town of Tsukimine is in terrible danger. Every month, on the night of the full moon, horrible demons try to conquer the town, and only the aloof, beautiful Sumire can stop them!

At least, that was what Sumire thought… until, on one moonlit night, she encounters a boy from her high school.
This boy is called Yuuki, and he awakes to powers much like hers. Once ignorant of the demonic threat that plagued his town, he must now go toe-to-toe with these monsters, and prove himself to Sumire as a proficient demon hunter!

Yuuki’s quest won’t be easy, though… Particularly when these demons are of a rather salacious bent! Using their mystical powers, these demons will do all they can to destroy Sumire’s dignity, and turn her into Yuuki’s personal pet!

Will Yuuki and Sumire be able to survive this night? Who’s controlling these demons, and for what cause?
Find out in Sakura Moonlight, the first part of the Moonlight series: a short visual novel with match 3 elements and an abundance of sexy scenes!
translation:
月峰镇正处于可怕的危险之中。每个月的月圆之夜，可怕的恶魔都会试图征服小镇，只有高傲美丽的堇才能阻止他们！

至少，堇是这么想的……直到，在一个月夜，她遇到了一名高中生的男生。
这个男孩叫优纪，他觉醒了与她很相似的力量。曾经对困扰他的城镇的恶魔威胁一无所知的他现在必须与这些怪物正面交锋，并向堇证明自己是一名熟练的恶魔猎手！

不过，有纪的任务并不容易……尤其是当这些恶魔具有相当淫荡的倾向时！这些恶魔将利用他们的神秘力量，竭尽全力摧毁堇的尊严，并将她变成有纪的私人宠物！

优纪和堇能熬过这个夜晚吗？谁在控制这些恶魔，出于什么原因？
在月光系列的第一部《樱花月光》中寻找答案：一部带有三消元素和大量性感场景的视觉短篇小说！
